Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Does the vampire return to its previous owner if it stops being *malkavian as soon as it becomes not *malkavian before the next unlock phase?

Does the vampire return to its previous owner on the next unlock if it stops being *malkavian?

Name: Malkavian Dementia
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U]
Cardtype: Master
Master.
Take control of a ready Malkavian that another Methuselah controls until your next unlock phase.
Artist: Anson Maddocks

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Thanks

Second answer surprise me.

You mean that if I get, with malkavian dementation, a malkavian vampire and then use clan impersonation to change the clan or, use derange and then Martinelli's ring to burn the derange card, I would keep the vampire?

Name: Clan Impersonation
[AH:C2, CE:C]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action.
Choose a clan and put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire is considered to be of the chosen clan instead of his or her original clan (if any). This vampire can burn this card as an action.
Artist: Max Shade Fellwalker

Name: Derange
[Sabbat:R, CE:R, Third:R]
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Malkavian/Malkavian antitribu
This is a +1 stealth action.
Put this card on a younger vampire. The vampire with this card is considered to be the same clan as the acting vampire. The vampire with this card does not unlock as normal. During his or her controller's unlock phase, he or she may burn 1 blood to unlock. The vampire with this card may move it to another vampire as a  action. This card cannot be placed on a Malkavian or Malkavian antitribu.
Artist: Eric LaCombe

Name: Martinelli's Ring
[Third:R, KoT:PV, POD:DTC]
Cardtype: Equipment
Unique.
The bearer cannot have or be the target of cards requiring Malkavian, Malkavian antitribu, Dementation [dem] or Serpentis [ser] (any of these are burned).
Artist: Eric Lofgren

Thanks
